summary: Psychic ramp deck: pile Basic {P}/Telepath energy across all your Pokemon, then Mega Gardevoir ex 'Mega Symphonia' deals 50 x (count of {P} energy on ALL your Pokemon).

expected_dmg.formula: damage = 50 * P_count ; P_count = number of energies providing {P} attached across ALL my Pokemon (basic {P} id5 + Telepath id19). Prism id16 provides {C}(type0) on non-basic and does NOT count. Location (active vs bench) is irrelevant to damage.
expected_dmg.probe: pcount 3->150, 4->200, 5->250 observed; Gardevoir holding [5,5,5,0,0]=3P+2Prism dealt 150 (Prism excluded).

expected_dmg.formula: damage = 0 (accel). Attaches 1 Basic {P} from DECK to each Benched Pokemon; effective attaches = min(bench_count, basic_{P}_remaining_in_deck). Whiffs to 0 once the 7 basic {P} are spent.
expected_dmg.probe: attach count 0-3 observed, frequently 0 at bench=5 when deck P pool exhausted.

expected_dmg.formula: damage = 100 to any 1 opponent Pokemon (displayed 0; ignores Weakness/Resistance on Bench)
damage = 200 fixed; self-lock: this Pokemon can't attack next turn (tempo self-harm)

early.until: no 747 in play (Gardevoir not yet evolved)
early.on_plan: by T2: >=1 Ralts/Kirlia in play, >=2 {P} energy banked on bench (Smoochum Delightful Kiss is free), Rare Candy or Kirlia+747 reachable via Hilda/Ultra Ball/Poke Pad

mid.on_plan: 747 online by ~T3 (Rare Candy Ralts->747 confirmed legal), Overflowing Wishes used >=1 on a wide bench, P_count >= 5 by T4

late.on_plan: Mega Symphonia >= 250 every turn; Boss's Orders drags the lethal/high-value target; take >=2 prizes/turn; keep P_count >= 5 by recovering discarded {P} with Wondrous Patch/Night Stretcher

doctrines.name: Symphonia ramp (primary)
doctrines.plan: Build wide bench, accelerate {P} everywhere (Overflowing Wishes + Smoochum + Wondrous Patch), then Mega Symphonia for 250-500 taking multi-prize KOs; single fed Gardevoir (360HP) can win alone if it survives.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: mean P_count at first Mega Symphonia and its damage; want P_count>=5 / damage>=250

doctrines.name: Secondary-attacker tempo (plan B)
doctrines.plan: If 747 can't assemble, race with Latias ex Eon Blade (200, self-lock), Lillie's Clefairy Full Moon Rondo (bench-scaling), Fezandipiti Cruel Arrow (100 snipe, 3C).
doctrines.discriminating_metric: play_rate[184]+play_rate[272]+play_rate[140] vs play_rate[747]; and win rate in games where 747 never evolves

doctrines.name: Energy concentration vs spread
doctrines.plan: Put {P} on high-HP mons (2nd 747 / 184 / 272) so gust/snipe KOs don't erase Symphonia count, vs spreading on all bench for more OW sinks.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: P-energy removed from board by opponent KOs per game; want low

tensions.balance: Use Overflowing Wishes (0 damage) only while P_count < A and no lethal Mega Symphonia is available; otherwise fire Symphonia. A in {4,5,6}

Discard Basic {P}(id5) to Ultra Ball/Secret Box/Mystery Garden ONLY if a recoverable copy exists (Wondrous Patch id1146 / Night Stretcher id1097 available and >=1 {P} in discard); prefer discarding Prism id16 to Mystery Garden since Prism never counts for Symphonia
Keep {P} energy concentrated on >=100HP Pokemon; avoid loading 30HP Smoochum / 70HP Ralts that get sniped for free, since each KO'd holder subtracts its {P} from Symphonia count

hypotheses.claim: Discard-cost engines (Ultra Ball, Secret Box, Mystery Garden) pitch Basic {P} Energy (id5) or combo pieces (Rare Candy id1079 / Mega Gardevoir id747), permanently lowering the Symphonia ceiling (only 7 basic {P} exist) or breaking assembly.
hypotheses.direction: count of Basic {P} discarded-and-not-recovered per game should be ~0 (<=1)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Forbidding all {P}/combo discards can brick Ultra Ball/Secret Box when the only discardable cards are energy, stalling the search engine
hypotheses.scenario: Hand = {Ultra Ball, 2x Basic {P}, Rare Candy, 747}; engine plays Ultra Ball and discards the 2 Basic {P} (and later has no Wondrous Patch/Night Stretcher), capping Symphonia at 50*(P already down).
hypotheses.pattern: self-harm effect unconditional firing -> board-state gate

hypotheses.claim: Lillie's Determination (shuffle entire hand into deck, draw 6/8) fires on the generic hand<=5 draw gate while holding an assembled/lethal combo (Rare Candy + 747, or the energy needed this turn), shuffling the win back into the deck.
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1227] ~0 on turns where hand contains Rare Candy+747 or a lethal line is present
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Never resetting a bad hand keeps the deck bricked; Determination is also the main refill and the +8 draw at 6 prizes is a real engine
hypotheses.scenario: Hand size 5 = {Rare Candy, 747, Basic {P}, Boss's Orders, Poke Pad}; a Ralts is active/benched; engine plays Determination and shuffles the whole combo away instead of Rare-Candying into 747.

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders (id1182) is under-used because Mega Symphonia shows 0 displayed damage, so the generic gust gate (own active displayed >=60) never fires and the deck misses lethal/prize-grab targeting.
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1182] > 0 whenever real Mega Symphonia damage (50*P_count) >= HP of a reachable benched target and it advances the prize race
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Gusting every turn wastes the 2 copies and can pull a Pokemon that is safer left benched; limit to real-lethal or 2-for-1 prize swings
hypotheses.pattern: scale attack under-evaluated -> real-dmg formula to shared perception

hypotheses.claim: The 7-card Basic {P} pool is consumed by manual attach + Smoochum + discard costs, so Overflowing Wishes whiffs (0 attach) and P_count plateaus below KO thresholds; the deck-specific feeding plan (conserve basic {P}, recycle via Wondrous Patch/Night Stretcher) is not followed.
hypotheses.direction: P_count at first Mega Symphonia >= 5 in majority of games; Overflowing Wishes should attach >0 when used
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Hoarding basic {P} in hand instead of banking it on bench delays the count and wastes free Smoochum accel
hypotheses.pattern: energy to unintended target -> deck-specific feeding plan

hypotheses.claim: Ramp-vs-fire timing is mistimed: engine fires Mega Symphonia at low P_count (weak hit, wasted Gardevoir turn) or loops Overflowing Wishes too long and never closes.
hypotheses.direction: do not fire Symphonia below P_count=A unless it is lethal; do not use Overflowing Wishes once P_count>=A with a lethal available
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: A too high stalls into passivity (harmful in this env) and lets opponent set up; lethal must always override the ramp gate

hypotheses.claim: Meowth ex Tuck Tail (return this Pokemon + all attached to hand) fired when it holds Symphonia-counting energy removes that {P} from the count, and if it is the only Pokemon in play it is an instant loss.
hypotheses.direction: Tuck Tail attack rate ~0 unless bench>=1 AND Meowth carries no needed {P} energy
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Meowth's value is the on-play supporter search (Last-Ditch Catch), not Tuck Tail; blocking Tuck Tail entirely is usually correct so low risk

hypotheses.claim: Rare Candy (id1079) / evolution priority stalls because Mega Gardevoir ex shows 0 displayed damage on both attacks; the L0 'evolve into max displayed damage' rule can deprioritize the win-condition line versus 200-damage Latias, delaying 747 online.
hypotheses.direction: 747 reaches play by ~T3 when Rare Candy + line are available
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Forcing Rare Candy every time can burn it when Kirlia is already down and natural evolution is fine; Rare Candy is a 2-of
hypotheses.pattern: scale/utility evolution under-evaluated -> deck-specific evolve priority

hypotheses.claim: Mega Gardevoir ex is Weakness Dark x2 (id747 weak=7) with 360 HP; any Dark attacker doing >=180 achieves a 3-prize OHKO. Over-committing energy to a single Gardevoir vs a Dark board loses the game in one hit.
hypotheses.direction: vs Dark boards, maintain a second attacker / do not stack the whole count onto one exposed 747

threshold.value: have a 2nd fed attacker before committing

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Refusing to commit the primary attacker forfeits the deck's whole plan; only hedge when opponent shows Dark

hypotheses.claim: Mystery Garden / Munkidori Adrena-Brain and other off-type effects can misfire: Adrena-Brain requires {D} energy, which the deck supplies only via Prism-on-a-Basic (2 copies, 1 type at a time); L0 may treat Munkidori as an active sniper it cannot actually power.
hypotheses.direction: Adrena-Brain fires only when a Prism provides {D} on Munkidori; otherwise Munkidori is a benched Mind-Bend/support body
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Blocking Prism-on-Munkidori removes a real damage-move engine when it IS set up

hypotheses.claim: Deckout is a tail risk: heavy draw/search (Determination draw 6/8, Hilda, Mystery Garden, Kirlia Call Sign, Xerneas Geo Gate) thins the 60-card deck, but Determination reshuffles the hand and Night Stretcher/Wondrous Patch recycle, so deckout should be a minority loss.
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Stopping the draw engine to save deck starves the {P} feed; only throttle searching when deckCount is very low and board is set
hypotheses.pattern: deckout -> stop-digging gate when deck thin
